youtube.title: Edgar Allan Poe got $9 for The Raven. The bird wants a cut 🖤 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Edgar Allan Poe's "The Raven" made him famous overnight… and reportedly paid him about $9. 🖤

Team Poe or Team Raven? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: "The Raven" ran in January 1845 and became a sensation. Poe was reportedly paid around $9 for it, stayed broke, and people would follow him in the street flapping their arms and croaking "Nevermore." Happy Halloween 🎃
